interaction.title: Interaction
interaction.description: A private multi-turn journal entry and AI reflection session for an authenticated user.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owning user.

title.description: Title or topic of the journal reflection.

prompt.description: Initial journal entry or user reflection prompt.

response.description: Gemini AI reflection, summary, or response.

mode.description: Mode of reflection: reflect, brainstorm, summarize, or chat.

messages.description: Ordered multi-turn dialogue history within this journal thread.

tags.description: Optional category tags for filtering entries.

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp or server timestamp when the entry was created.

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp or server timestamp when the entry was last modified.

generalInquiry.title: GeneralInquiry
generalInquiry.description: A direct general knowledge question and AI response logged for an authenticated user.

id.description: Unique identifier for the general inquiry.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owning user.

question.description: Direct question asked to the Gemini API.

response.description: Gemini AI answer and general knowledge response.

category.description: Optional category or topic for the inquiry (e.g. Science, Tech, Philosophy).

modelUsed.description: Gemini model that generated the response.

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when the inquiry was asked.

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp when the inquiry was last updated.

/users/{userId}/interactions/{interactio.description: User-isolated document storage for private journal reflections and chat conversations with Gemini.

/users/{userId}/general-inquiries/{inqui.description: User-isolated document storage for direct general knowledge questions and Gemini responses.
